bifrost: springboard/render/src/colorfx.rs (per-pixel colour adjustments and effects), springboard/render/src/colorcube.rs (3D colour lookup table), springboard/render/src/gradient.rs (linear and radial gradient ramps), springboard/render/src/gfx.rs (CPU Image, blur), springboard/render/src/imgdec.rs (PNG/JPEG decode), springboard/render/src/glass.rs (material blur and saturation), springboard/src/shell/photos/edit.rs (photo filters, app-private), springboard/src/gpu/shaders.rs (GPU presenter shaders, not app-facing)
summary: Core Image's filter graph (CIContext, CIImage, CIFilter chains, CIKernel) has no app-facing counterpart. BifrOSt has pure per-pixel colour adjustments, a colour lookup table and gradient ramps in the render crate, plus fixed image operations inside the renderer and the Photos app (blur, brightness and contrast, four photo looks, rotate and crop, PNG and JPEG decode). Apps get no SDK API for any of them yet.

features.note: The renderer's Image is CPU pixels only; no SDK type wraps it as a lazily evaluated image with a render context

features.bifrost: none in the SDK; springboard/src/shell/photos/edit.rs (Edit pipeline, fixed order); springboard/render/src/colorfx.rs (free functions, no filter object)
features.note: Photos runs a fixed sequence (crop, straighten, filter, brightness, contrast). colorfx gives pure functions an app can call, but there is no filter object and no chaining by name

features.feature: Blur filters (gaussianBlur, boxBlur, motionBlur, zoomBlur, discBlur)
features.apple: CIGaussianBlur, CIBoxBlur, CIMotionBlur, CIZoomBlur, CIDiscBlur, CIBokehBlur
features.note: Only a CPU blur of repeated box passes, plus the GPU backdrop blur for materials (springboard/render/src/glass.rs). No motion, zoom, disc or bokeh blur, and no radius or sigma API

features.feature: Colour adjustment (exposure, brightness, contrast, saturation, hue, temperature, tone curve)
features.apple: CIColorControls, CIExposureAdjust, CIHueAdjust, CITemperatureAndTint, CIToneCurve, CIVibrance, CIGammaAdjust
features.bifrost: springboard/render/src/colorfx.rs (exposure, saturation, contrast, hue_rotate, temperature_tint); springboard/src/shell/photos/edit.rs (adjust, brightness and contrast only); springboard/render/src/glass.rs (saturation at :74)
features.note: colorfx adds exposure, saturation, contrast, hue rotation and a temperature and tint gain model, all pure. Not yet wired into Photos or an SDK API. No vibrance, tone curve or gamma. The temperature model is a gain approximation, not a white-point conversion

features.feature: Photo and colour effects (sepia, mono, noir, vignette, false colour, posterize)
features.apple: CIPhotoEffect* (chrome, fade, instant, mono, noir, process, tonal, transfer), CISepiaTone, CIVignette, CIFalseColor, CIColorPosterize, CIColorInvert
features.bifrost: springboard/render/src/colorfx.rs (sepia, invert, posterize, vignette); springboard/src/shell/photos/edit.rs (Filter enum: Original, Vivid, Mono, Noir, Warm; apply at :98)
features.note: colorfx adds sepia, invert, posterize and vignette as pure pixel functions. Photos still has its own four looks and does not use colorfx. No chrome, fade, instant, transfer or false colour

features.feature: Colour lookup and conversion (colour cube, colour map, Lab, palettize)
features.apple: CIColorCube, CIColorMap, CIPalettize, CIConvertLab, CIConvertRGBtoLab, CIColorCubeWithColorSpace
features.bifrost: springboard/render/src/colorcube.rs (ColorCube: red-fastest table, trilinear lookup); springboard/src/media/convert.rs (BT.601/BT.709 YUV to RGBA for video, :49 and :130)
features.note: A 3D colour cube of up to 64 samples per axis with trilinear lookup. Nothing builds a cube from a colour map or a palette, and there is no Lab conversion, colour space or palettize

features.feature: Geometry adjustment (affine transform, crop, rotate, scale)
features.apple: perspectiveTransform(), perspectiveCorrection(), lanczosScaleTransform(), bicubicScaleTransform(), straighten(), keystoneCorrectionCombined()
features.bifrost: springboard/render/src/gfx/rotate.rs (rotated at :157, bilinear), springboard/src/shell/photos/edit.rs (Edit: turns, crop_zoom, straighten)
features.note: Quarter-turn and bilinear rotation exist, and Photos applies crop and straighten. No general affine or perspective transform for apps

features.apple: CISourceOverCompositing, CIMultiplyBlendMode, CIScreenBlendMode, CIOverlayBlendMode and the other composite and blend filters
features.bifrost: docs/bifrost-ui.md (blit_vibrant: plus-lighter in Dark, plus-darker in Light); springboard/src/gpu/batch.rs (push_shadow)
features.note: Blend is fixed to the vibrancy label case and shadows. No general blend mode or composite operator selection

features.feature: Image decoding into the filter input (CIImage from data or file)
features.bifrost: springboard/render/src/imgdec.rs (decode at :12: JPEG and PNG to premultiplied RGBA, MAX_SIDE 8192)
features.note: JPEG and PNG only. No RAW decode (CIRAWFilter), no HEIF, and no colour-managed input

features.apple: CIKernel, CIColorKernel, CIWarpKernel, CIBlendKernel, CISampler, Core Image Kernel Language and Metal kernels
features.bifrost: springboard/src/gpu/shaders.rs (presenter shaders, internal to the shell)
features.note: The GPU shaders serve the compositor only. Apps cannot supply a kernel or a custom filter

features.feature: Feature detection (CIDetector: faces, rectangles, text, QR and barcodes)
features.apple: CIDetector, CIFaceFeature, CIRectangleFeature, CITextFeature, CIQRCodeFeature, CIQRCodeDescriptor and the other barcode descriptors
features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/detect.rs (data detectors for text, not image detection)
features.note: No face, rectangle, text or barcode detection on images. The data detector works on text only

features.feature: Generators and gradients (checkerboard, stripes, linear and radial gradient, QR and barcode generators)
features.apple: CILinearGradient, CIRadialGradient, CICheckerboardGenerator, CIStripesGenerator, CIQRCodeGenerator, CIRoundedQRCodeGenerator and the other generator filters
features.bifrost: springboard/render/src/gradient.rs (Ramp colour stops, linear_t and radial_t offsets); springboard/src/gpu/batch.rs (rounded rect and shadow quads only)
features.note: Linear and radial gradients as pure per-point sampling over a colour ramp. No checkerboard, stripes, barcode or QR generators, and the shell's own gradients are not built on this module yet

features.feature: Render destinations and video filtering (CIRenderDestination, CIImageAccumulator)
features.note: Frames reach the screen through the shell presenter. No app API for rendering filtered frames to a destination

gaps: No app-facing filter API: no filter object, no chaining, and no SDK type for a lazily rendered image (image and context equivalent). colorfx, colorcube and gradient are render-crate functions, not SDK types.
Colour adjustment is pure in colorfx but not wired into Photos or an SDK API. Missing: vibrance, tone curve, gamma, and a white-point based temperature conversion.
Blur limited to one CPU box-blur path and the GPU material blur. Missing: motion, zoom, disc, bokeh, masked variable blur, and a radius or sigma API for apps.
No feature detection (faces, rectangles, text, barcodes) and no barcode or QR generation.
No custom kernel or custom filter extension point for apps (Core Image Kernel Language or Metal).
Image input limited to JPEG and PNG. No RAW (CIRAWFilter), no HEIF, no colour-managed decoding path for apps.

Photo effects beyond sepia, invert, posterize and vignette are absent (chrome, fade, instant, transfer, false colour). Colour map, palettize and Lab conversion are absent; the colour cube exists but nothing builds one from a map or palette.
Gradient generators beyond linear and radial ramps are absent (checkerboard, stripes).
